name: French Island

facts.claim: French Island National Park covers heathland and open woodland and holds Victoria's most significant koala population
More than 230 bird species recorded, plus the long-nosed potoroo and released eastern barred bandicoots
Reached by Western Port Ferries passenger ferry from Stony Point (10-12 minutes to Tankerton Jetty) or from Cowes
Fairhaven Campground is a 5 km walk or ride from Tankerton Jetty

name: State Coal Mine

facts.claim: Former state-owned black coal mine at Wonthaggi, operational 1910 to 1968, now a Parks Victoria heritage attraction
Guided underground tours (60-90 minutes) run daily at 11.30am and 2.00pm; children must be 5 or older
Entry to the aboveground attractions, visitor centre film and heritage trail is free
The drift car that carried visitors out of the mine has been suspended since 2020; walking tours resumed in 2024

cost_note: Underground tour adult $25.50; aboveground precinct free

name: Meeting of the Waters

facts.claim: Junction Park in Wentworth, NSW, is where the Darling River meets the Murray, the two longest rivers in Australia; it includes a lookout
Wentworth lies at the confluence of the Darling and Murray rivers, about 20 km west of Mildura
The Wentworth Trail passes heritage buildings and landmarks near the park, starting at the visitor information centre

name: Australian Inland Botanic Gardens

facts.claim: Community-created botanic garden at Buronga, NSW, billed as the Southern Hemisphere's first semi-arid botanic garden
Plantings showcase Australian arid and exotic flora, including a rose garden of over 1,600 bushes
Entrance is free, gold coin donation welcome
